Import a Telegram export to turn your channel into a searchable library. Original messages stay intact.

Drop your export hereTelegram JSON, HTML, or a library backup
How to export a Telegram channel
  1. In Telegram Desktop, open the channel and choose Export chat history from its menu.
  2. Choose JSON if available. HTML exports are also supported.
  3. Import result.json, or choose all messages.html pages from the exported folder.

If your Telegram app has no export option, use the cross-platform Telegram Desktop app. The native macOS app may not offer exports.

Your records are saved in Cloudflare R2. Imports, notes, indicators, and original files are available on your other devices after signing in. A downloaded JSON backup contains records and links to your private originals.
